info.title: TheBoosh.Zone API
info.description: API for Alex Beahm's personal portfolio and blog website, featuring article management, tagging system, and admin authentication.

get.description: Returns the health status of the application.
Returns the readiness status of the application, including database connectivity.
Returns application metrics in Prometheus text format for monitoring and observability.

schema.example:
# HELP http_requests_total Total HTTP requests
# TYPE http_requests_total counter
http_requests_total{method="GET",endpoint="/api/articles",status="200"} 42

post.description: Authenticate admin user and create session
End admin session. Requires valid CSRF token in request body or X-CSRF-Token header.

get.description: Get a fresh CSRF token for authenticated users to use with state-changing operations

post.description: Change the password for the authenticated admin user (requires CSRF token)

get.description: Retrieve published articles with pagination and filtering
Retrieve a single published article by slug
Get most popular tags by usage
Retrieve all articles including unpublished (admin only)

post.description: Create a new article (admin only). Requires valid CSRF token in request body or X-CSRF-Token header.

get.description: Retrieve article by ID including unpublished (admin only)

post.description: Upload an image or media file (admin only). Requires valid CSRF token in request body or X-CSRF-Token header.

get.description: Retrieve all uploaded media with pagination (admin only)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search in filename, alt_text, or caption

get.description: Retrieve a single media item by ID (admin only)

put.description: Update alt_text and caption for media (admin only)

delete.description: Delete a media file and its database record (admin only)

get.description: Retrieve the current radio playlist URL and optionally parse tracks

parameters.name: parse
parameters.description: Whether to fetch and parse the .m3u file (0 or 1)

post.description: Update the radio playlist URL (admin only). Requires valid CSRF token.

playlist_url.description: URL to .m3u or .m3u8 playlist file (HTTP(S) or local path)

delete.description: Delete the current radio playlist configuration (admin only)

get.description: Get synchronization information for the radio stream, including server time and calculated playback position

csrf_token.description: CSRF token for use with subsequent authenticated requests
CSRF token for authenticated users (only present when authenticated=true)
Fresh CSRF token for use with state-changing operations
Valid CSRF token for request authentication

view_count.description: Aggregated view count for the article

duration.description: Track duration in seconds (-1 if unknown)

error.description: Optional error message if parsing failed

total_duration.description: Total playlist duration in seconds (null for live streams)

elapsed_time.description: Elapsed time since playlist start in seconds

current_position.description: Current position within current loop in seconds

current_track_index.description: Index of current track in playlist

is_hls.description: Whether this is an HLS stream

CsrfTokenInvalid.description: CSRF token is missing, invalid, or expired

tags.name: Metrics
tags.description: Prometheus metrics for monitoring and observability
